responsibility: Objective-C++ declaration and statement adaptation layer that reuses C++ parser machinery for ObjC constructs: it synthesizes struct/class definitions, finishes Objective-C ivar-containing structs with duplicate-field checks, forces function bodies to be expanded into RTL, forwards tag lookup and type-comparison helpers, and wraps compound-statement entry/exit to match Objective-C++ scope handling.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the ObjC++ declaration remapping layer: it defines the wrapper functions that adapt C++ front-end behavior at runtime, including struct start/finish handling, RTL generation for finished functions, tag/type helpers, and compound-statement scope cleanup. Unlike the header twin, this file contains the executable bridge logic rather than preprocessor remapping declarations.
